content.text: Hey, it's Xiao Pi's first time here, check out his jersey selfie!
@Xiao Pi, you look very energetic, and the jersey suits you well.
@Xiao Pi, but remember to wear running gear next time, it'll make running more comfortable.
@Xiao Pi Nice jersey, it feels very energetic!
Haha, thank you! But Da Liu's knee pads look very professional.
@Big Liu, your knee pads are actually thicker than your legs. Take good care of yourself!
@DaLiu, it's important to be mindful of how you use knee pads; don't let them interfere with your recovery.
@Big Liu, looks like you'll have to be careful running today.
Now, let's take a look at our running shoes group photo. Is everyone ready?
@Peach Our shoes look very professional, looking forward to this run!
@Peach What an interesting angle, I'll have to take photos like this next time.
@Peach Everyone's shoes are so unique; I love this group photo.
@Peach It seems we're both well-prepared. Today is going to be amazing!
Alright, everyone, let's set off once you're all ready!
Be safe, and remember to drink plenty of water after your run!
We've finished the run, and everyone is very happy. Take a look at this group photo.
@Coach Zhang, we're all drenched in sweat, it's so exhilarating!
@Coach Zhang It seems everyone ran very hard, looking forward to the next time.
After running, it's good to replenish some nutrients. The light food on this table looks great.
@Ricky I'm here to check if the calorie content of these light meals is appropriate.
@Ricky These salads are very healthy, but are you concerned about the calorie content of the salad dressing?
Look at this calorie chart; the calorie content of salad dressing really needs attention.
@Dr. Wu, it seems we need to control the amount of salad dressing, otherwise all the effort from running will be wasted.
I couldn't resist ordering a beer to celebrate.
@Iron Sister, drink beer in moderation so it doesn't affect our workout results.
@Iron Sister, it's okay to drink some beer in moderation. Everyone is very happy today.
Compare this, this is how I used to look. Although there hasn't been much change, I will continue to work hard.
@DaLiu, you've already made progress. Just keep it up.
@DaLiu Although the changes are not significant, the effects of a healthy lifestyle will gradually become apparent.
Come on, everyone, raise your glasses to celebrate and look forward to the performance next season.
Everyone, take a look at this change. @大刘, you've really made a lot of progress!
@Coach Zhang Indeed, we can all see Liu's hard work.
@Big Liu, but I think you can still push a bit harder. We all support you!
@Big Liu, your perseverance is truly admirable to all of us. Keep up the great work!
@Big Liu, I think you could adjust your diet and exercise routine for better results.
Thank you for your support. I will keep working hard!
The calorie content of this light meal really surprised me. @Dr. Wu, what do you think?
@Xiao Pi Yes, the calorie content of salad dressing is not to be overlooked, so you all should be more mindful of it!
@Dr. Wu, thank you for the reminder. We will be more careful next time.
It seems we need to change our dining style for the next gathering, focusing on health while also keeping an eye on calorie intake.
Indeed, this way everyone can better maintain their condition.
Finally, let's all raise a toast to celebrate and look forward to the next season!
@Coach Zhang Thank you all for your support. I will definitely work even harder next season!
@Coach Zhang, cheers! Looking forward to a better performance next time!
@Coach Zhang, cheers, let's keep up the good work together!
@Coach Zhang, cheers, looking forward to the next running event!
@Coach Zhang, cheers, let's keep up the good form!
Though I'm not there in person, I raise my glass with you all and wish everyone good health!
Thank you, Dr. Wu, for your remote guidance. We will definitely keep running in a healthier way!
@Dr. Wu, thank you for your advice. I will keep it in mind.
Today's event was fantastic, looking forward to gathering again next time!
Yeah, today's group run was so much fun, everyone was amazing!
I feel like our team is becoming more and more vibrant!
Looking forward to the next run and dinner, creating more wonderful memories together!
Have a safe journey, see you next time!
Take care, everyone. Looking forward to seeing you again next time!
I'll try harder next time. Let's all keep pushing forward!
Looking forward to the next even more exciting event!
Everyone, go back and rest well, and continue to strive hard next time!
See you next time, everyone!

meta.full_summary:
对话开始。
(第2段摘要): 大家讨论了小皮的首次亮相，调侃了大刘的护膝，欣赏了跑鞋合影，并准备开始跑步。
(第3段摘要): 大家成功完成了跑步活动，讨论了餐后的轻食和啤酒。吴医生远程点评了轻食的热量，特别是沙拉酱的热量问题。大刘展示了自己的变化，大家举杯庆祝并期待下个赛季的表现。
(第4段摘要): 在庆祝跑步活动成功后，大家讨论了轻食的热量问题，并为大刘的进步感到欣喜。最后，全员举杯庆祝，并期待下一次的活动。
resolved_events: 大家对大刘护膝的调侃已解决
吴医生远程点评餐后热量
